items.label: Classic & Stylish Design
items.value: KIGOTY 7-piece patio furniture sets showcases a classic look that fits well with various outdoor decor styles. This practical patio conversation set includes 4 armless chairs, 2 armrest chairs and 1 coffee table, ideal for daily leisure and casual gatherings.

items.label: 【Built Tough
items.value: Sturdy Steel Frame & All-Weather PE Rattan】 Engineered for years of outdoor use, this set is built on a rust-resistant powder-coated steel frame. The UV-protected PE synthetic wicker is hand-woven to resist fading, cracking, and peeling through sun, rain, and temperature swings—delivering the classic rattan look without the high upkeep. Each seat supports up to 350 lbs.

items: 【Modular 7-Piece Design Fits Your Space】 This set includes 4 Armless Chairs, 2 Corner Chairs, and 1 Coffee Table, offering flexible arrangement options for your porch, poolside, or balcony. Connector clips keep the sections securely aligned, while the modular design makes it easy to rearrange for different occasions—hosting friends or stretching out solo.

【Practical Coffee Table & Easy-Clean Surface】 The included coffee table features a smooth easy-clean surface that resists scuffs and wipes down in seconds. Its simple, lightweight design makes the set easy to reposition, adapting quickly to any outdoor layout.

items.label: Simple Assembly
items.value: This complete patio conversation set includes detailed instructions and all necessary hardware for easy assembly. The outdoor seating set may arrive in multiple boxes on different days. Product size: 101"D x 47"W x 26"H.

items.label: Additional Features
items.value: Armrest, Easy to Assemble, Removable Cushion

items.label: Included Components
items.value: Armless Chair, Armrest Chair, Patio Conversation Sets
